text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali held a meeting with Prime Minister Hamed Karoui on the modernization of professional training. the High Council of Professional Training to hold a meeting on June 21.
- President Ben Ali received a report from Communications Minister Ahmed Friaa on telecommunications projects.
- Tunisia's consumer price index (CPI) remained unchanged in May compared to its level in April.
- BIAT bank to issue GDRs on the international market.
- Minister for Presidential office Mohamed Jegham to open on Tuesday the 31th session of Sfax International Fair.
- Apricot production in Kairouan is expected to rose by 15 percent to 11,000 tonnes compared with last harvest.
